adversarial_test_results.prompt: She tapped her debit card at the checkout to pay for groceries.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests a listed commercial compound (debit card) in a novel checkout context unlike the hacking/lost-item examples.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: He opened a checking account at the local credit union last Tuesday.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests generalization to a new commercial compound of the same form (checking account) in a credit-union context.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: My grandmother finally replaced her old mobile phone with a smartphone.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests a listed compound (mobile phone) in a novel family-upgrade context.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: I missed three phone calls from the insurance agent yesterday afternoon.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests a listed compound (phone calls) with an insurance-agent context absent from the examples.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Our customer service team will return your phone call within the hour.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests a listed compound (phone call) combined with the claimed customer-service commercial context.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She redeemed the remaining balance on her gift card before it expired.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests generalization to a new commercial modifier (gift card) expressing the same consumer-payment concept.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: He played a wild card that changed the outcome of the poker game.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the peak noun card but swaps in a non-commercial modifier (wild card, a game term).

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She wrote a heartfelt message inside his birthday card yesterday.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps card with a social, non-commercial modifier (birthday card).

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The teacher handed out the final report card on Friday afternoon.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps card with a school, non-commercial modifier (report card).

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The immigration officer asked to see his green card application.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps card with a government-ID modifier (green card), not a commercial purchase compound.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She shuffled the playing cards before dealing another hand.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the plural cards with a games modifier (playing cards), not a commercial compound.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The library keeps a detailed account of every manuscript in its archive.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses account in its narrative-record sense with no commercial modifier before it.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Please phone me when you arrive at the train station.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses phone as a verb with no compound structure at all.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The hiker answered nature's call and stepped behind the trees.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses call in its bodily-need idiom sense, not a commercial phone compound.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The referee made a bad call that enraged the stadium crowd.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses call as a referee's decision, sharing the trigger word but not the feature.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She felt a divine call to devote her life to charity work.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Uses call in its divine-vocation sense suggested by WordNet, with no phone modifier.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: His credit score dropped after missing several loan payments.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the commercial topic and modifier credit but drops the head noun, so no second-word compound occurs.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The bank offers savings plans and investment advice for retirees.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Keeps the commercial topic and modifier savings but drops the head noun account.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The account was closed after months of inactivity and unpaid fees.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Presents the head noun account alone in a commercial setting, which the hypothesis says activates only weakly.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The phone rang loudly in the empty hallway.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Presents phone alone with no commercial modifier, testing that the head noun by itself is insufficient.
